items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 117:1
items.html: The nine Sefirot of every stature are alluded to in the names of HaVaYaH and their fillings. The nine Sefirot of the stature of AB: its Keter is alluded to in the simple HaVaYaH alone, for every Keter is the root of the stature, and the simple HaVaYaH is the root of all the fillings that come in it. And the Sefira of Hochma of AB is the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, as follows: Yud, Hey, Vav, Hey. And the Sefira of Bina of AB is the HaVaYaH of Yudin in the filling of the filling, as follows: Yud Vav Dalet, Hey Yud, Vav Yud Vav, Hey Yud — which are 28 letters. And the Sefira of ZA of AB, namely its HGT NHY, is the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, like the Sefira of Hochma of AB, for in this ZA is equal to Hochma, in the secret of "his name is MA and the name of his son is MA, as you know." And thus the nine Sefirot of the face of the stature of AB are explained, and this is only the aspect of the first nine [Sefirot] of every Sefira, which are the male of this stature. But the Malchuts of every Sefira, which are the left side of the stature, namely the aspect of the Nukva within his body, are the aspect of the number and Gematria of the four kinds of HaVaYaH mentioned above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 117:2
items.html: (To the question) For the Malchut of Keter is the number of the four letters of the simple HaVaYaH, which is 26. And the Malchut of Hochma is the number of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, which is 72. And the Malchut of Bina is the number of the 28 letters of the HaVaYaH of Yudin in the filling of the filling, which are 610. And the Malchut of ZA is 72, namely the number of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin. And thus the Malchuts of the nine Sefirot of the face of the stature of AB are explained. (Item 147).
